title: C24 Large-scale normalized state (seller data-grid)

files_forbidden: all app/(challenges)/* directories not belonging to this task

acceptance_criteria: Seller grid entities are stored in a normalized shape (by-id map plus id array) rather than nested arrays, and normalize.ts converts the repository's seeded data into that shape.
Memoized selectors derive view data so that updating one row does not recompute unrelated derived state (selector memoization demonstrated/asserted).

The grid virtualizes rows so only visible rows are rendered for a large dataset, and editing/selecting a single row does NOT trigger a re-render storm across all rows (documented via render-count instrumentation in NOTES.md).
NOTES.md explains the normalization + memoized-selector + virtualization strategy and which re-render pitfalls each one prevents.

The c24 _meta folder contains spec.md (non-empty acceptance criteria), defend-it.md (3-5 from-memory questions with model answers), verification.md, and a discoverable challenge.config.ts; seed data is read via local _lib over lib/data without editing lib/data.
output_format: code plus plain English explanation of every non-obvious decision
